project.name: anchor
project.description: Modular CLI and optional server for managing paths, scripts, files, secrets, environments, and infrastructure workflows through anchors — executable, metadata-rich JSON objects.
project.philosophy: Treat configuration, environments, and actions as executable knowledge. Every anchor is portable, inspectable, and composable.
project.version_notes: Evolving from a shell utility to a complete DevOps/developer tool.

entry_points.bash_wrapper: functions/anchors.sh — defines the anc() shell function, routes all subcommands, calls Python CLI
entry_points.python_cli: core/main.py — argparse-based entry point, registers all subcommands

known_issues_and_observations.dual_implementation: Many features are partially implemented in Bash (functions/) and Python (core/). The Bash layer calls Python for most operations but some logic is duplicated.
known_issues_and_observations.functions_dir_is_legacy: The functions/ directory contains older Bash implementations that are increasingly superseded by anchor/ Python code.
known_issues_and_observations.no_tests: No test directory or test files found in the project.
known_issues_and_observations.server_auth_optional: Server integration and LDAP are optional; CLI works fully offline.
known_issues_and_observations.wf_py_large: core/commands/wf.py is 590 lines — a primary refactor candidate.
known_issues_and_observations.sible_py_large: core/commands/sible.py is 299 lines — secondary refactor candidate.
known_issues_and_observations.url_py_large: core/commands/url.py is 287 lines — secondary refactor candidate.
known_issues_and_observations.cd_requires_shell_shim: Unix process isolation means a subprocess cannot change the parent shell's cwd. The anc shell function in anchor/shell/anc.sh is mandatory for local anchor navigation. For local anchors it reads the JSON directly (jq or python3 -c) to avoid any Python CLI startup.
known_issues_and_observations.ssh_agent_requires_openssh_client: SshHandler uses ssh-agent + ssh-add for in-memory key injection. Requires openssh-client (ssh-agent, ssh-add, ssh binaries). sshpass is optional for password auth injection.

SPA knock hardening — two fixes for concurrent-attack scenario (attacker with stolen TOTP seed running N parallel processes): (1) unique index on vpn_leases.uid in MongoDB to collapse lease race to a single insert; (2) mark TOTP code as used after successful verify_otp by storing {uid, otp_code} in a TTL collection (30s) with unique index on (uid, otp_code) — closes the only vector that nonce anti-replay does not cover.

Vault TTL + one-time secrets: add expires_at (MongoDB TTL index, auto-delete) and one_time flag (delete-on-read in GET /vault/{path}) to secret documents. CRITICAL: expires_at and one_time must be in the creator-only ACL bucket in PUT /vault/{path} — same as groups/users. If treated as a general editor field, any user with edit access can set expires_at=null and bypass the TTL. Currently expires_at is not processed in PUT at all (safe by omission), must stay creator-only when implemented.
future_ideas: VPN anchor type: new type='vpn' with provider field (wireguard|openvpn|anchor-spa) and linked_secret holding the credentials/config. Handler fetches secret at runtime and injects it — user knows nothing. WireGuard: key from vault → _wg_up() via stdin pipe (pattern already exists). OpenVPN: .ovpn from vault → openvpn --config /dev/stdin. Anchor SPA: provision token from vault → existing vpn up flow. No state complexity needed beyond what the kernel already exposes.

LONG TERM — Browser extension (Maskit integration): merge maskit plugin with anchor. Phase 1 (do after anc mask CLI): connect maskit plugin to vault via GET /masks/<name> so profiles are centrally managed instead of localStorage — same seed across machines = consistent placeholders. Phase 2: intercept AI submissions (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) and apply active mask profile before sending. Phase 3 (only if users ask): secret injection into form fields as password manager replacement. Deliberately deferred: injection adds UX and security surface complexity, focus first on masking which has the compliance/legal sales angle.

LONG TERM — GUI client for non-technical users: desktop or web UI (Electron or Tauri, or just expand the existing server web UI) that exposes anchor navigation, VPN toggle, secret access, and file restore without any CLI knowledge. Core design constraint: must not expose raw secret values by default — same vault philosophy, the UI injects/uses secrets without showing them. Target persona: a team member who needs VPN + credentials + project access but is not a developer.

LONG TERM — Automated workspace onboarding: a single command or token that fully configures a new user's environment — pulls their anchors, injects their secrets, brings up their VPN, sets up SSH keys and GitHub access. Builds on the existing provision token concept but extended to the full workspace: 'anc onboard <token>' and the machine is ready to work. Eliminates the need for the user to manually run multiple 'anc' commands or know what anchors exist. Admin defines the workspace profile (which anchors, which secrets, which VPN) and the token encodes it.

VERY LONG TERM — Windows compatibility: the core blocker is that WireGuard management (ip link, wg set), ssh-agent injection, and shell integration are Linux/macOS-specific. WSL2 is a partial path but not a real solution for non-technical users. Native Windows would require: WireGuard Windows API (wireguard-nt), Windows OpenSSH agent (Pageant or the built-in), and a PowerShell or winget-based installer. Not worth approaching until the Linux/macOS surface is stable and there is concrete user demand.

refactor_log.change: Implemented anc mask — new anchor type='mask' for sanitizing sensitive data before piping to AI tools. (1) MaskAnchor model (models/anchor.py): rules list (regex→placeholder) + builtin list (ip/email/phone/iban/card). (2) anchor/commands/mask.py: stdin pipe masking with [[ PLACEHOLDER ]] format, AI-facing header comment explaining placeholder consistency, built-in pattern detectors from maskit project, mapping persistence (~/.anchors/mask_maps/) for unmask round-trips, --rules/--add/--rm for rule management. (3) anc set --mask <name> --builtin ip,email for creating mask anchors. Usage: cat error.log | anc mask company | claude.

Critical VPN fix — three bugs preventing anc vpn up from establishing tunnel. (1) knock.py: missing guard for sidecar client=None — created phantom onboarding leases without registering WireGuard peer. (2) sidecar wg.py: ip route add replaced with ip route replace (idempotent), added stale peer eviction before registering new peer, raise on route failure instead of silent swallow. (3) Dockerfile: added iproute2 (was using BusyBox ip which lacks 'ip route replace'). (4) ui/router.py: fixed TemplateResponse API for Starlette 1.0 (positional args changed). (5) ROOT CAUSE: sudo password prompt hidden by Rich spinner in _wg_up — added sudo -v before console.status() to cache credentials. Reduced post-knock sleep from 5s to 1s. All fixes deployed to production server via SSH.

Rewrote completions/anc bash completion script for the new anchor/ Typer CLI. Covers: bare anchor name dispatch (pos 1), all subcommands (login, set, pull, push, ls, path, go, cr, rc, cp), secret subgroup (ls/get/push/update/del), vpn subgroup (init/up/down/status). Dynamic anchor name completion reads $ANCHOR_DIR/~/.anchors/data/*.json. Per-command flag completion (ls: -f/-t/-r; go: --pubkey; cp: -e/--exclude/-n/--dry-run; ls --type: anchor type values). cp anchor/path completion resolves anchor base_path via jq and completes subdirectories. Security hardening — WireGuard private key no longer written to /dev/shm. Replaced _wg_up() (wg-quick + tmpfs config file) with direct wg+ip commands: ip link add, ip addr add, wg set private-key /dev/stdin (key passed via subprocess stdin pipe, never touches any filesystem), wg set peer, ip link set up, ip route add. Added _wg_iface_exists() for idempotency (tears down stale interface before re-creating). Error path does cleanup via ip link del. Updated docs/security/vpn.md: rewrote section 2 to document the stdin pipe model, added explanation of the old /dev/shm approach and why it was replaced, updated threat model table and key storage summary. Also updated module docstring to drop wg-quick dependency.

Fixed three bugs in SPA knock/reprovisioning flow: (1) admin_revoke_otp ($unset) borraba vpn_uid junto con otp_seed_enc — al re-provisionar assign_vpn_uid asignaba un uid nuevo (IP diferente), causando IP mismatch: WG handshake pasaba (es DH puro) pero HTTP a través del tunnel fallaba → lease quedaba stuck en onboarding. Fix: solo hacer $unset de otp_seed_enc; vpn_uid es estable y se preserva. (2) admin_provision_otp y admin_provision_full siempre llamaban generate_otp_seed() — cada re-provisión generaba un seed nuevo e invalidaba el QR del usuario en su authenticator app → TOTP incorrecto → knock silenciosamente dropeado → peer nunca registrado → 0 B received → handshake timeout. Fix: reutilizar seed existente con get_otp_seed(); solo generar uno nuevo si no existe (primera provisión). Para resetear intencionalmente el seed: DELETE /admin/users/{u}/otp primero. (3) CLI: aumentado sleep post-knock de 3s a 5s para dar más margen al thread pool del servidor + sidecar.

Memory-only WireGuard config + client isolation: (1) anchor/commands/vpn.py — removed WG_CONF constant and _write_wg_conf()/_wg_quick() functions; replaced with _wg_up() (ip link add + wg setconf /dev/stdin + ip addr add + ip route add — never writes PrivateKey to disk), _wg_down() (ip route flush + ip link del), _wg_update_routes() (wg set peer allowed-ips + ip route flush/add for hot-reload). Updated all call sites: both PRE-PROVISIONED and SPA KNOCK paths now use the new helpers. Fixed vpn_down to use _wg_down() instead of wg-quick. (2) MongoDB: updated wireguard integration routes from ['10.13.13.0/24'] to ['10.13.13.1/32'] for client isolation — clients only route to the server VPN IP, not to each other.

Knock flow debug and fix: Diagnosed that anc-server container was running OLD SPA v1 code while source had SPA v2 (X25519/ECIES). Full debug revealed: (1) Container code mismatch — rebuilt anc-server from source, deploying spa.py v2, knock.py v2, router.py v2, server.py v2, config.py v2. (2) pycryptodome missing from requirements.txt — added it (vault/crypto.py uses Crypto.Cipher). (3) SPA_PRIVKEY_B64 env var not in docker-compose.yml — added it (references .env value SPA_PRIVKEY). (4) Dockerfile missing --log-level info — added to uvicorn CMD so app logger INFO messages appear in docker logs. (5) VPN routes stored as ['10.13.13.1'] (no CIDR, same as onboarding) — fixed in MongoDB to ['10.13.13.0/24']. (6) router.py:233-234 NameError — lease_hours/expires_at undefined, fixed to lease_secs/expires_at_iso. (7) manu user had no vpn_uid or otp_seed_enc — re-provisioned (vpn_uid=6, new TOTP seed). (8) logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO) added to server.py so knock listener and SPA init logs are visible. Knock flow verified end-to-end: SPA packet build/parse symmetric, UDP knock received, onboarding lease created with state=onboarding+assigned_ip=10.13.13.6, peer added to sidecar.

VPN lease settings sync fix: (1) Backend — PATCH /vpn/admin/users/{username}/settings ahora actualiza expires_at del lease activo del usuario si existe, usando provider.get_effective_lease_seconds() con la nueva política. Si el lease es infinito (0) setea expires_at=null; si tiene duración fija recalcula desde now. (2) Frontend — saveUserSettings() llama Promise.all([loadVpnUsers(), loadLeases(), loadLivePeers()]) en lugar de solo loadVpnUsers(), para que columna Expires y Live Peers reflejen el cambio inmediatamente sin esperar el próximo poll de 30s.

VPN lease management overhaul: (1) Per-user lease duration — nuevo campo vpn_lease_minutes en user doc (null=global, 0=infinite, N=minutes). provider.py: nuevo método get_effective_lease_seconds(user_doc) que resuelve duración efectiva. integrations/wireguard/models.py: validator de lease_hours acepta ahora 0=infinite. (4) endpoints/admin.py: /admin/users devuelve los tres campos VPN por usuario. assign_vpn_uid: fix para DBs existentes con vpn_uid=2 stale. Añadida constante DYNAMIC_UID_MIN=3. assign_vpn_uid() ahora detecta UIDs en rango reservado (<3), los limpia del user doc y cae al contador para asignar uno válido. Doble safety net: si el contador mismo devuelve un uid <3, lo fuerza a DYNAMIC_UID_MIN-1 y reincrementa.

Static admin peer + sidecar protection: (1) server/docker-compose.yml: added PEERS=peer1 to wireguard service (linuxserver generates static peer at 10.13.13.2, config in ./wireguard/config/peer_peer1/); added WG_PROTECTED_IPS=10.13.13.2 env var to wg-sidecar service; updated header comment to document peer1 IP reservation. (2) server/wireguard/sidecar/app/wg.py: added _PROTECTED_IPS frozenset from WG_PROTECTED_IPS env var; add_peer() raises WireGuardError if allowed_ip is protected; remove_peer() resolves peer IP first then raises WireGuardError if protected — both paths completely block any modification to the admin backdoor peer.

VPN SPA onboarding — three critical bug fixes + vault secret restored with full peer config: (1) server/code/vpn/spa.py: TIMESTAMP_WINDOW 2→30 seconds — 2s was too tight (silently dropped valid packets due to processing latency); 30s matches TOTP window while nonce TTL still prevents replay. (2) server/code/vpn/knock.py: idempotency check — allows re-knock for stale onboarding leases (cleans up old peer, deletes stale lease, re-registers), blocks only for state=active. (3) anchor/commands/vpn.py: moved getpass/password prompt OUTSIDE console.status() context — Rich's live-rendering hides the prompt. Also: knock sleep 1→2s, handshake timeout 10→20s. (4) server/code/vpn/router.py: admin_generate_otp fully restores server-side provisioning — generates WireGuard keypair (cryptography X25519), allocates IP via uid_to_ip, registers peer on sidecar, creates active lease, saves full wg.conf (with PrivateKey) as vault secret 'vpn/{username}', returns token with wg_privkey+wg_pubkey+assigned_ip+routes. Added optional description param to _save_vault_secret. (5) anchor/commands/vpn.py PRE-PROVISIONED path: split-tunnel up → handshake → auth → /vpn/sync → syncconf hot-reload with full routes (instead of staying on server_vpn_ip/32 split-tunnel forever).

VPN SPA flow fix — knock listener + pure-SPA provision + peer1 IP reservation: (1) docker-compose.yml: added 62201:62201/udp port to wireguard service (knock listener port); added VPN_KNOCK_PORT=62201 env var to anc-server; updated header comment. (2) server/code/vpn/router.py admin_generate_otp: stripped to pure SPA flow — removed X25519 keypair generation, sidecar add_peer, vault secret save, lease creation. VPN SPA — bug fixes for pre-provisioned tunnel flow: (1) anchor/commands/vpn.py: added PRE-PROVISIONED PATH fast-track in vpn_up() — when config has wg_privkey (server generated keypair), skip SPA knock + onboarding tunnel + authenticate + promote steps (all of which fail because server-provisioned leases are state='active' not 'onboarding'); write full AllowedIPs=0.0.0.0/0 config directly and wg-quick up. This was the root cause of 100% packet loss: promote 404 → wg-quick down → no tunnel → no route to 10.13.13.1. (2) server/wireguard/sidecar/app/wg.py: add_peer() now also calls `ip route add {ip}/32 dev wg0` after `wg set` so the server kernel has an explicit host route for the peer IP — `wg set` alone does not add kernel IP routes, which would prevent reply packets routing back through wg0 on servers with Address=/32 instead of /24. remove_peer() now looks up the allowed_ip from wg dump before removal and calls `ip route del {ip}/32 dev wg0` to clean up.

WireGuard VPN SPA Onboarding — Fases 2, 3 y 4: (1) server/code/vpn/otp.py — assign_vpn_uid() (atomic counter, UID=1 reserved for server), generate_otp_seed() (pyotp.random_base32 + AES-256-GCM+HKDF encryption via vault/crypto), get_otp_seed() (decrypt), verify_otp() (pyotp.TOTP valid_window=1). (2) server/code/vpn/spa.py — SPA packet format (154 bytes: 64B uid_raw + 16B nonce + 58B ciphertext + 16B tag), AES key derivation HKDF-SHA256(seed_bytes, salt='spa-v1', info=uid), build_packet() for CLI, parse_packet() for server (silent drop on any failure), uid_to_ip() deterministic IP calc (stateless). (3) server/code/vpn/knock.py — KnockProtocol(asyncio.DatagramProtocol): parse_packet → nonce anti-replay (vpn_nonces unique index) → verify_otp → vpn_uid lookup → uid_to_ip → sidecar.add_peer (AllowedIPs=ip/32) → vpn_leases insert state='onboarding' expires_at=now+5min. start_knock_listener() coroutine started from lifespan. (4) server/code/vpn/router.py: POST /vpn/admin/users/{username}/otp (admin: assign_vpn_uid + generate_otp_seed, returns vpn_uid + seed_b32 + provisioning_url), DELETE /vpn/admin/users/{username}/otp (revoke), POST /vpn/promote (authenticated: promote onboarding→active lease, return full WG config with AllowedIPs=0.0.0.0/0). (5) server/code/integrations/wireguard/models.py: knock_port + server_vpn_uid fields. (6) server/code/config.py: VPN_KNOCK_HOST + VPN_KNOCK_PORT env vars. (7) server/code/server.py: lifespan starts knock listener if WireGuardProvider is enabled and knock_port > 0. (8) server/init-mongo.js: vpn_nonces (unique nonce index + TTL 60s on created_at) + vpn_uid_counter collections. (9) anchor/commands/vpn.py: anc vpn up (wizard + SPA knock + wg-quick up + handshake poll + JWT auth + promote + wg syncconf hot-reload + Rich panel), anc vpn down (wg-quick down + best-effort DELETE /vpn/lease), anc vpn status (server lease + wg show). (10) anchor/cli.py: registered vpn subgroup. (11) pyproject.toml: vpn optional dep group (pyotp>=2.9, pycryptodome>=3.19).

Fixed login↔secrets redirect loop + session expiry management: (1) Root cause: login.html init() only checked localStorage token existence (not JWT expiry), so expired tokens still triggered redirect to /ui/secrets. All 401 handlers in page scripts redirected to /ui/login without clearing localStorage, so login page immediately redirected back — infinite loop. (2) base.html: added tokenIsExpired(token) helper (decodes JWT payload, checks exp*1000 < Date.now()), clearSession() helper (removes anc_token/anc_user/anc_groups), updated appShell init() to validate expiry (not just existence), added _startSessionWatcher() with setInterval 60s that auto-logouts on expiry and sets sessionExpiresSoon flag when <5min remain, added 'Session expires soon' warning banner in sidebar. (3) login.html: added tokenIsExpired() helper, updated init() to check expiry before redirecting to /ui/secrets — clears stale session data if expired. (4) secrets.html, anchors.html, users.html, logs.html: all 401 handlers now call clearSession() before location.href='/ui/login' to break the loop.

SSH secure connection + shell performance: (1) anchor/handlers/ssh.py — replaced paramiko with native ssh client + ssh-agent temporal. Flow: vault → PEM string in RAM → ssh-agent -a tmpdir/agent.sock (0700) → ssh-add - (stdin pipe, zero disk) → ssh SSH_AUTH_SOCK=socket → kill agent (SIGTERM). Fixed IdentitiesOnly=yes bug (was blocking agent auth). Added _normalize_pem() for keys stored with literal \n. Added _key_error_hint() for actionable error messages. Password via sshpass -d fd (not cmdline). (2) anchor/commands/go.py — added --pubkey flag: extracts public key from vault PEM via ssh-keygen -y -f /dev/stdin, prints line ready for authorized_keys. (3) anchor/shell/anc.sh — rewrote local routing: reads JSON directly with jq (5ms) or python3 -c minimal (30ms) instead of two Python CLI startups (600ms+). SSH still routes to anc go (single Python startup). cd for local is now near-instant. (4) install.sh — wrapper copy now diffs src vs dst: shows 'updated' vs 'up to date', shows reload warning only when changed. (5) docs/security/ssh.md — full security doc: problem statement, vault+agent flow diagram, security properties table, residual risks (swap, core dumps, root, MitM), usage guide. (6) pyproject.toml — paramiko removed entirely (was optional [ssh], now not needed).

Fixed anchors UI expand row: Alpine.js v3 x-for requires a single root element inside <template> — having two sibling <tr> caused the second (expanded JSON) row to be silently ignored. Fixed by wrapping both <tr> in a <tbody> per iteration (valid HTML: a table can have multiple tbody). Also removed max-h-72 from the <pre> so the full JSON is visible without vertical scroll. Removed x-cloak from the expand row (x-show already handles initial visibility).
